title: The first item, or a fallback
hints: A list has two shapes, so the `match` needs two cases: `[]` and `x :: _`.
The empty list has no first item, so that case gives `default`. In the other case the first item already has a name.
`match l with` then `| [] -> default` and `| x :: _ -> x`

answer.code:
let first_or default l =
  match l with
  | [] -> default
  | x :: _ -> x
answer.explain: The function matches on the two shapes of a list. For `[]` there is no first item, so it gives back `default`. For `x :: _` the first item is `x`, and the rest of the list is not needed, so the pattern uses `_` for it.
